about_the_game:
Take control of the cute but efficient ninja

Become Thregnar as he is on a quest to destroy the powerful Crystals of Chaos before they can fall into the wrong hands. In order to save the world, Thregnar much traverse through over 30 challenging levels, take on difficult boss fights, and stop the menacing Grandmaster Casimir from obtaining the crystals first.

Dive kick to victory

Thregnar comes equipped with his trusty blade, a seemingly endless supply of shuriken, and most importantly, his legendary dive kick. Thregnar's dive kick can be used to boost off of enemies, bounce up walls, and extend your jump's horizontal trajectory. Learning to master Thregnar's abilities is key to overcoming any obstacle.

Upgrade your arsenal

Thregnar is not alone on his journey. The elderly adventurer Clutch is here to help. Clutch can take resources gathered in levels and upgrade your abilities.

Beyond the campaign

Thregnar and the Crystals of Chaos features a number of unlockable content. After you finish the story, you gain access to The Dojo; A gauntlet mode where Thregnar must face every enemy and boss with only a single life. On your adventure, you may discover Hidden Scrolls which can be viewed in The Gallery. Scrolls will let you get up close views of every character and learn more about the world Thregnar inhabits.
